verdict.rationale: Justworks documents a native Xero integration where users connect their Xero account, map pay types to Chart of Accounts, and override mappings by department/office/employee — indicating an automated payroll-to-accounting sync. However, evidence only covers Xero, not QuickBooks, and lacks detail on sync frequency, journal entry format, or reliability confirmation. Missing for 10: QuickBooks integration evidence, confirmation of automatic (vs. manual-trigger) sync cadence, and independent/hands-on validation of the sync working correctly.
